display_information.name: AI Safety Opportunities
display_information.description: Shares posts from your public opportunities channel to aisopportunities.com
display_information.long_description: Feeds the public AI-safety opportunities board at aisopportunities.com. The bot reads only public channels it is explicitly invited to whose names contain "opportunities". Messages tagged [private], [uni-reserved], school-specific, internal, or do-not-share are discarded at ingestion and never published. React with the lock emoji (or edit a message to add [private]) to remove a published item; uninstalling the app deletes everything your workspace contributed. Fully open source: github.com/kaustubhkislay/aisafety-opportunities
